ana: Quick sync 0min1 on auth RFC follow-up. I'm proposing a compact claims-first token: svc_id, tenant_id, scope, caps, plus optional assertion_id referencing server-held delegation proofs. Pros/cons?
jules: Pros: smaller tokens, clearer semantics, avoids brittle name parsing. Con: possible extra lookups for delegation.
remy: How do we keep hot path fast? p50 auth must stay <10ms.
sophia: Use in-node LRU cache + small on-disk snapshot for restarts. Add a bloom filter to avoid unnecessary proof fetches.
kai: Measure tail. If p99 rises, consider batching assertion fetches at the router.
maria: Migration plan? We have many legacy api keys like org:svc:legacy.*
ana: (typo) ana: Plan: silent-accept mode for v1 + /token/exchange to mint v2 claims tokens. SDKs emit a non-fatal migration header x-auth-migration when v1 is used.
remy: Auditability: store hash(orig_key) + resolved claims + ts, sample 1% for full records, retention 30d. No raw keys.
sophia: RBAC: capability-first policy language (verb:resource). Roles are aliases for convenience.
maria: TTLs: delegation proofs 15m, svc tokens default 12h, operator keys 1h. All tokens support revocation.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: will add canary for /token/exchange in us-west-2, flag=claims-exchange, 5% rollout.
jules: Action items: 1) sophia+kai prototype cache+bloom and perf tests (due Fri). 2) remy+maria draft migration playbook + audit spec (PR next Tue). 3) devex to add SDK header and migration CLI. I'll draft claim schema and examples.
sophia: I'll add a sample v2 token snippet to the doc and an example curl exchange flow.
ana: (typo) ana: schedule architecture review next week to sign off. :thumbsup:
